=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED 2026-06-08 (via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/functions/datetime.html) ===
• day_of_week(x) — verbatim: 'Returns the ISO day of the week from x. The value ranges from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).'
• EXTRACT(DAY_OF_WEEK FROM x) — works; returns same ISO 1..7 (Mon..Sun) per the EXTRACT supported-fields list (r23:1179 + r13:5677 already document the list verbatim: YEAR, QUARTER, MONTH, WEEK, DAY, DAY_OF_MONTH, DAY_OF_WEEK, DOW, DAY_OF_YEAR, DOY, YEAR_OF_WEEK, YOW, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND, TIMEZONE_HOUR, TIMEZONE_MINUTE).
• EXTRACT(DOW FROM x) — parses (DOW is the documented alias for DAY_OF_WEEK), returns same ISO 1..7 — does NOT flip to Postgres 0=Sunday convention.
• dayname() — NOT in Trino 467 datetime functions page. Function-not-registered if called.
• format_datetime(timestamp, format) -> varchar — verbatim: 'Formats timestamp as a string using format … compatible with JodaTime's DateTimeFormat pattern format.' Joda 'EEEE' = full English weekday name ('Monday'..'Sunday'); 'EEE' = 3-letter short form. First arg typed TIMESTAMP, not DATE — must CAST a DATE first (signature verified, matches r23:401 existing format_datetime-needs-timestamp inoculation).
